[Regulations made by Board of
Trustees .in exercise of the powers con ferred by section 45 of the Employees'
Old‑Age Benefits Act, 1976, (XIV of 1976), the same having h.‑,en
previously published as required by sub‑section (1) of the said section.

1. Short title and commencement.‑‑- (1) These
regulations may be called the. Employees' Old‑Age Benefits (Determination
of Wages for Compulation of Contributions) Regulations, 1980.
(2) They shall cerise into force
at once.
2. Definitions.--‑ In these regulations, unless there is
anything repugnant to the subject or context,‑‑‑‑
(a) Act means the Employees' Old‑Age
Benefits Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976) ;
(b) Institution means the
State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan exercising and performing the
powers and functions of the Institution under the Act ;
(c) "prescribed
percentage" means the rate specified in subsection (1) of section 9 of the
Act ; and
(d) Words and expressions
used but not defined in these regulations shall have the same meanings as in
the Act.
3. Wages paid or payable at a faxed time.‑-- Where wages arc
disbursed on monthly basis, the contribution shall be computed at the
prescribed percentage of such wages.
(2) Where wages
are disbursed on fortnightly basis, the daily wage shall be calculated by
dividing such wages by thirteen and the contribution shall be compute at the
prescribed percentage of the daily wage multiplied by the actual number of days
for which the wages are payable in the month.
(3) Where wages
are disbursed on weekly basis, the daily wage shall be calculated by dividing
such wages by six and the contribution shall be computed at the prescribed
percentage of the daily wage multiplied by the 'actual number of days of which
wages are payable in the month.
(4) Where wages
are disbursed on daily basis, the contribution shall be computed at the
prescribed percentage of the daily wage multiplied by the actual number of days
for which wages are payable in the month.
(5) Where wages
are disbursed for part of the month or the week, the daily wage shall be
calculated by dividing such; wages by the actual number of days worked and the
contribution shall be computed at the prescribed percentage of the daily wage
multiplied by the actual number of days for which wages are payable in the
month.
4. Arrears of wages.‑--- (1) Where arrears of wages, arising
out of mis calculation in the past, or other administrative reason, are paid,
the contri bution shall be computed at the prescribed percentage of such wages
and paid as short payments for the period to which arrears relate. A detailed
statement giving particulars of such arrears shall also be annexed with the Pay‑in‑Slip
(Form PR‑03).
(2) Where
arrears of wages are paid to a person continuing in the insure able employment
due to increase in wages retrospectively, such arrears shall be deemed to be
part of wages for the month in which it is paid, irrespective of the period to
which they relate.
(3) Where
arrears of wages are paid to a person who has left the insur able employment
due to increase in wages retrospectively, such arrears shall be deemed to be
part of wages for the month in which wages were lag paid /payable to him and
contribution shall accordingly be computed and paid as abort payment for that
month.
5. Wages paid in advance.‑‑ Where wages are paid in
advance, such wages shall be split up for the period of months to which they
relate and contribution shall be payable as if the wages were paid every month
regularly.
